behavior.payloads: Build and hash-check one lazy bucket per running worker; at most three FormData payloads live in this pool, no whole-session base64 materialization
behavior.preflight: All requested hashes validated before custom hook or any bucket POST; same-bucket and cross-bucket duplicates both rejected
behavior.fencing: Current claim checked for session and immediately before each bucket POST; recheck stop flag after awaiting claim
behavior.failure: First observed failure stops new bucket admission; local catches let Promise.all wait for every running bucket and pending fence before throwing first error
behavior.completion: Nonempty session returns only after every bucket successfully acknowledges and a completion JWT is retained regardless of response order; an early JWT cannot hide a later failure
behavior.zeroBucketCase: Session JWT remains the completion token with zero asset POSTs
behavior.apiAndReceipts: Same endpoints, JWT-only upload auth, status validation, manifest digest/counts, module/version upload, activation and durable uncertainty policy

proof: Maximum3 actual in-flight bucket requests and each bucket POST exactly once

HTTP500 and ambiguous timeout stop new admissions, preserve first failure, wait all in-flight without retry

Empty session/custom connector completion and incomplete session refusal unchanged
Existing module byte containment, tilde names, immutable Worker-ID upload, CPU/startup and V1 claim/ownership/recovery checks pass
